original: ॥ upamanyukṛtaśivastotram ॥

original: jaya śaṅkara pārvatīpate mṛḍa śambho śaśikhaṇḍamaṇḍana ।

original: kṛpayā'bhayadena cakṣuṣā sakaleneśa vilokayāśu naḥ॥ 4

original: tvadanusmṛtireva pāvanī stutiyuktā na hi vaktumīśa sā ।

original: saviṣo'pyamṛtāyate bhavāñchavamuṇḍābharaṇo'pi pāvanaḥ

original: hṛdaye smṛta eva dhīmate namate'bhīṣṭaphalaprado bhavān ॥ 8

original: abhayaṃ kuru tāvadāśu me gatajīvasya punaḥ kimauṣadhaiḥ ॥ 9

original: saviṣairiva bhīmapannagairviṣayairebhiralaṃ parikṣatam ।
analyzed: saviṣaiḥ iva bhīma pannagaiḥ viṣayaiḥ ebhiḥ alam parikṣatam

analyzed: munayaḥ bahavaḥ udya dhanya tām gamitāḥ sva abhimata artha darśinaḥ

original: karuṇākara yena tena māmavasannaṃ nanu paśya cakṣuṣā ।। 11

original: virahīva vibho priyāmayaṃ paripaśyāmi bhavanmayaṃ jagat ॥ 12

original: bahavo bhavatā'nukampitāḥ kimitīśāna na mānukampase ।

original: dadhatā kimu mandarācalaṃ paramāṇuḥ kamaṭhena durdharaḥ ॥ 13

original: aśuciṃ yadi mānumanyase kimidaṃ mūrdhni kapāladāsa te ।

analyzed: upamanyu kṛtam stava uttamam prajapet yaḥ tu śivasya sannidhau

original: śivalokamavāpya so'cirātsaha tenaiva śivena modate ॥ 17
analyzed: śiva lokam avāpya saḥ ucirāt saha tena eva śivena modate 17

original: ityupamanyukṛtaṃ śivastotraṃ sampūrṇam ॥
